decisions.reason: The handle family remains an open real option because demand uncertainty is high and catalogue maintenance costs are low.
The mitred design is still an unresolved design bet, and low keeping costs justify holding the option.
Multifunctional features give it further upside and no negative evidence yet exists to abandon the option.
Although it is generic and overlaps with other options, early uncertainty and low holding costs argue for retention.
The German Design Award signals realized value, making drop unlikely and supporting further commitment.
The finish is a low-cost aesthetic option whose market acceptance is still uncertain, so it is kept while that uncertainty resolves.
